rules.message: name follows the skills-ref rules: NFKC, lowercase letters, digits and '-', no leading, trailing or double '-', at most 64 characters
rules.fix: Write the name in lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens (for example pdf-summarizer), at most 64 characters.

source.section: name field (must match the parent folder name)

rules.message: name '{left}' must equal the folder name '{right}'
rules.fix: Rename the folder or the frontmatter name so they are identical.

source.house: Claude skill authoring best practices: a skill name cannot contain the reserved words anthropic or claude (cited at eva.py RESERVED_NAME_WORDS; no dated record)

rules.message: name has no reserved word (anthropic, claude)
rules.fix: Remove the reserved words anthropic and claude from the name.
